review_text:
Прожили 10 дней в Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — как раз в пик сезона, во время Гран-при Формулы-1. Выбор отеля оказался удачным: несмотря на высокую загрузку, всё работало слаженно и без сбоев.

Питание — одно из главных достоинств. Особенно впечатлили морепродукты: !краб!, устрицы, мидии, разные виды рыбы — подавали регулярно и с разной подачей, так что интерес не угасал даже к концу отпуска. Шведский стол действительно богатый — столы буквально «ломятся» от блюд, в том числе и с местными, и с интернациональными акцентами. Десерты - отдельная история, самый Чизкейк на всем белом свете. В мясном ресторане а-ля карт очень приятный официант София)

Пляжная зона — отдельное удовольствие. Песок мелкий, белоснежный, ухоженный — ни ракушек, ни камней. Вход в море очень плавный, вода прозрачная и чистая. На каждом лежаке есть кнопка вызова официанта, персонал очень оперативно приносит коктейль, свежайшие фрукты и снеки.

В целом, Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — это отель для тех, кто ценит спокойствие, качественное питание и продуманный сервис без излишней театральности. За 10 дней ни разу не захотелось «сбежать» куда-то — всё, что нужно для настоящего отдыха, было под рукой.

name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text:
My partner and I stayed for 8 nights in November for the first time. I’ll start with the positives we experienced during our stay.
Firstly the location is perfect, you are equally close to Yas Island or the city and can enjoy exploring both, you’re also very close to the new cultural district which has museums to explore. The beach is stunning along with the sunsets you can view.
Next the service, every staff member there is incredibly kind and helpful, from the pool to each restaurant, they can’t do enough to help.
Finally the common areas are stunning, the decor is extravagant and clearly a lot of thought has been put into it.

Now onto the negatives, if you are not a family this is not the hotel for you. It is a predominantly family friendly hotel with only one main pool.
There is a huge kids pool with slides and a wave pool that was empty during our stay, we were told by staff that this was because alcohol is not served in these areas so the parents prefer the main pool. An easy fix would be to change this rule or something more permanent would be to build an Adults only pool. There were some areas of sun loungers that were adult only but they were not poolside and they also had children there with staff not enforcing the rule.
Onto the food, we were really disappointed in the quality of food at the resort, even in the al a carte restaurants, it was fine but not in standing with the cost of the stay. The drinks on offer were generally really good, except the wine, of which there were only two option of both red and white - both of which weren’t great.
The rooms themselves looked tired, I don’t think there has been any work done to maintain the standard since opening and it showed. Paint peeling and chipped, and general wear and tear on the furniture. We stayed in the fourth floor overlooking the pool in a sea view room, at multiple points during our stay there was a smell of sewage in the hallway. One evening we returned to our room  and the smell was incredibly strong inside, I called reception immediately to report it, they called back after 20 minutes to offer us a new room on the ground floor, but at this point is was 11pm and we were tired. My parents were staying two doors down and had the same issue and the same solution was offered however again not appropriate at the time, after a while the smell started to dissipate so we were able to get to sleep. The following day management followed up with my mum (not me) and offered the same room again, however we had selected the sea view rooms for exactly that so it wasn’t an appropriate compensation, they also offered my parents a discount upon their next stay.
I work in hospitality and this was shocking to me, you should not have to pay extra in order to solve a solution that has happened during this stay. The hotel could have easily offered a complimentary gesture such as resort credit and it would have been a welcomed, particularly given the cost of the stay.
Upon checkout nothing was mentioned to me at all, no apology or acknowledgment of the issue, so I asked to speak with a Manager. I explained the problem and advised how I was really disappointed with the communication and management of the whole issue, she had no idea about it and also no idea who had been communicating with my parents, but reassured me she would fix it as they had two more days left of their stay.
Unfortunately no one reached out to them at all, and upon checking out they were informed that a ‘free’ bottle of prosecco had been placed in their room - this was incorrect, so potentially was left in the wrong room - and again this is the same prosecco that is complimentary across the resort so no real effort.
It was an incredibly disappointing end to a mostly positive stay at the Rixos, I would encourage some Incident resolution training for their management along with taking the above feedback on board.
owner_answer:
Dear Mr. Sian,

First and foremost, we would like to sincerely thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback regarding your stay with us. Every review is very important to us, and we view them as an opportunity to improve and enhance our guests’ experiences. We truly apologize for anything that may have not gone the way you expected during your visit.

We are glad to hear that you enjoyed our prime location, stunning beach, sunsets, and the level of service provided by our team. It is also wonderful to know that you appreciated the design and ambiance of our common areas.

Regarding your concerns:

Family oriented hotel  and pools: Indeed, Rixos Premium Saadiyat is a family-oriented resort, and we welcome guests of all ages. While children are present in the main pool, we also have dedicated spaces for adults, including our Spa Pool and designated adult-only areas on the beach and around the pool, where guests above 18 can enjoy a more tranquil experience.

Food and beverages: Our team strives to offer high-quality dishes prepared with the finest ingredients, and our restaurants are well-known in the region for their culinary excellence. While we have a wide selection of alcoholic beverages available, including exclusive wines available at an additional charge, we apologize if our standard wine offerings did not meet your expectations.

Room conditions and hallway smell: We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused by the temporary issue in the hallway. Our engineering team addressed the matter immediately, and we apologize for any discomfort it caused during your stay. A room move and a gesture of apology were offered at the time, and we regret if this did not fully meet your expectations. Please be assured that we continuously work to maintain and improve the quality of our rooms and facilities.

Incident resolution and communication: We sincerely apologize for any miscommunication or delay in follow-up regarding this issue. Your feedback is invaluable, and we will review our internal procedures and provide additional training to ensure such situations are handled more efficiently in the future.

We are grateful for your constructive feedback and hope that, despite the inconveniences, you were able to enjoy many aspects of your stay. It is our sincere hope to welcome you back to Rixos Premium Saadiyat, allowing us the opportunity to provide a seamless and memorable experience.

Warm regards,
Guest Relation Team

name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text: Остановились в Club Prive по рекомендации моего агента, абсолютно не прогадали ☀️ |Наша компания большая, была выбрана вилла с 3 спальнями. |Нас радушно и гостеприимно встретили Саед и Махмуд с цветами, с игристым, с улыбками, очень приятно 💐 🥂 Впервые встречаю такое отношение к гостям: любые просьбы, любые мелочи выполнялись мгновенно и на все 100%. У ребенка был День Рождения, Саед и Махмуд организовали торт, украшение номера, организовали нам прекрасный день с выездом из отеля 🎂 |Также хочу сказать про уборку 🧹 Я очень привередливый человек в этом плане. Но и тут все на уровне, просто идеальная уборка, мне придраться не к чему было 😁|В целом очень приятные впечатления остались от жизни на вилле. |Хотелось бы отметить и ресторан Club Prive. Очень вкусно и великолепный персонал. На завтраках заряжают энергией и прекрасным настроением на весь день 😊 В любой момент, хоть ночью можно придти и вкусно поесть, или выпить шикарный коктейль, или угоститься вкуснейшим мороженым-все что душе угодно 24/7. |Пляж Club Prive: красивый, малолюдный. Ребята на пляже так же обеспечивают максимально комфортное времяпрепровождение, спасибо ☺️|В целом весь отель Rixos очень понравился. Все рестораны понравились, пляж отличный, территория ухоженная, музыканты в ресторанах, весь персонал выше всех похвал, просто абсолютно все на уровне! |Из небольших минусов: отсутствие туалета вблизи от пляжа и, может быть, хотелось бы реновации виллы, устаревшие интерьеры будто бы, но и этот момент как-то ушел на задний план благодаря заботе персонала о нашем отдыхе. |Спасибо  🫶🏼

name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.

name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.

review_text:
Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير
ويستحق الزيارة أكثر من مرة
ويستحق التقيم
ويستحق التجربه

Overall Snow Abu Dhabi experience is very nice but I would like to share my feedback regarding the photo package. Out of the 90 photos provided, only 17 are unique with different poses; the rest are duplicates or edited  (Photoshop) versions. In effect, there are fewer than 20 distinct photos.

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

name: The St. Regis Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Perfect place to experience New Year fireworks in Abu Dhabi

The St. Regis Abu Dhabi is an excellent choice for celebrating New Year’s Eve, especially if you want a premium experience with great views and comfort. The hotel’s Corniche location makes it one of the best spots to enjoy the New Year fireworks without dealing with overcrowded public areas.

The overall ambiance on New Year’s Eve is elegant and festive. The fireworks view from the hotel’s venues and nearby areas is fantastic, and the atmosphere feels exclusive yet lively. Everything is well organized, from entry to seating and service, which makes the experience smooth and enjoyable.

Service, as expected from St. Regis, is top-notch — staff are attentive, professional, and make you feel well taken care of throughout the evening. The food and drinks during NYE events are high quality, with good variety and presentation.

Kendine beş yıldızlı otelim diyen birçok otel St Regis i örnek almalı.

Check in işlemlerimizi kahvemizi içerek gerçekleştirdik.
Diğer konularda zaten çok çok iyiler ama beni en çok etkileyen bu oldu.

Bu resepsiyon alanını fotoğrafta da paylaşıyorum,kendine beş yıldızlıyım diyen oteller örnek alsınlar..

Vale ler harikalar,otel personeli mükemmel,kahvaltı çok lezzetliydi ama çeşit biraz arttırılabilir.
Ayrıca kahvaltı personellerinin bazıları St Regis e göre kalitesiz gözüküyorlardı.

Onun dışında otelde alkol fiyatları çok yüksekti,daha erişilebilir olması iyi olurdu.

Buradan otel yönetimine teşekkür ediyorum.

review_text:
I recently visited Surf Abu Dhabi, and it completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The staff were friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about surfing. The facilities are world-class, clean, and thoughtfully designed, creating the perfect environment for both beginners and experienced surfers.

The wave quality was unbelievable — consistent, powerful, and customizable to suit every level. It’s the closest thing you can get to surfing in the ocean, with the added bonus of perfect conditions every single session. The team does an amazing job keeping things safe, fun, and flowing smoothly.

A special shoutout to Grace, our surf coach, who made the whole experience even better. She was super knowledgeable, patient, and encouraging — her tips helped us improve quickly while keeping things relaxed and enjoyable. Grace’s energy and professionalism really stood out, and she made the session unforgettable.

If you’re in Abu Dhabi and love surfing (or want to learn), Surf Abu Dhabi is an absolute must-visit. I will defiently be back again to visit.

Thanks to all the team at Surf Abudabi 🙏

name: Surf Abu Dhabi
review_text: I can't say enough about this place. The facility is amazing , the staff is incredible and they go above and beyond to make you feel like vip customer. I was in Dubai on vacation with my wife and decided to go to Abu Dhabi and try it out on the last day of the trip. I was hesitant because I am 59 years old and the last time I surfed was 2 years prior plus my wife was going with me and I didnt know what she would be doing for a hour and a half while I was in the water, but she loved it. The second floor was a perfect place to have breakfast and watch the pool while the session was on.. Getting there , i was very nervous but the staff made me feel really relaxed and kept telling me not to worry because they would be in the water coaching me the whole time. The group in the water was awesome, everyone catching waves and having a blast . I was able to ride 8 waves and had the best time of my life. If you are a surfer or if you ever wanted to try to surf , you must go ! I guarantee you that you will never forget. It was worth every penny. Thank you for a amazing time.
owner_answer: Thank you Garden for sharing your experience! We're really glad you made the trip from Dubai and that both you and your wife enjoyed your time with us. It’s great to hear the coaching, atmosphere, and setup helped you feel comfortable and get back on the board. We'll be here whenever you're ready for another session, you're always welcome!

name: Surf Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Had a brilliant day at the Abu Dhabi surf club at the weekend. After a slightly inauspicious start when the Uber dropped me off at the wrong entrance (Uber's fault - folks, take a right at the roundabout when you see the club, not a left), we were greeted by super friendly and professional staff.

We spent the day with a bucket of beers next to the plunge pool (helpful in the July heat) on poolside chairs with complimentary towels and a big umbrella to provide the shade. Great service both poolside/lakeside throughout the day, lovely food at the adjactent Nalu restaurant and great vibes throughout - the vibe moves from chilled to party vibes as the day progresses, with a combination of live music and a dj. A bit loud for my tastes, but I'm a middle-aged man from the UK - everything is loud!

HUGE thanks to the amazing CLAUDIO, JACOBO and GIULIA. You were/are amazing and your professionalism, as well as your friendliness and ability to engage with all types of people at the venue make it the place it is. The facilities are great (kudos to the talented folks who designed, sourced/procured and project managed such a beautiful venue) and the people...............super/amazing. Bravo!
owner_answer: Thank you, Chris! We're glad you had a brilliant day with us, even with the Uber detour. It’s great to hear you enjoyed the vibe, service, food, and especially the hospitality from Claudio, Jacobo, and Giulia—we’ll make sure to pass on your kind words. Looking forward to welcoming you back again soon!

review_text:

I had Luke as my coach, and he was fantastic. This place is definitely a must go if you’re visiting Abu Dhabi !

name: Surf Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I recently visited Surf Abu Dhabi for a site visit to meet a client, and I must say, I was genuinely impressed by the overall setup and environment. Even though I didn’t surf or take any lessons, just being there gave a clear sense of how well-managed and thoughtfully designed the place is.
The facility is modern, clean, and very professionally maintained. The artificial wave pool looks spectacular powerful yet controlled and you can see the excitement and energy from the surfers enjoying their sessions. The staff were welcoming and helpful, and the entire atmosphere had a vibrant, beachside vibe right in the heart of Abu Dhabi.
It’s not just for surfers the location itself is worth visiting for meetings, inspiration, or just to take in the scene. And to top it off, they have a great restaurant on site where you can relax and enjoy a meal or coffee while watching the action. Looking forward to visiting again maybe next time with a surfboard 😉

name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
The Bridge wellness hub is an excellent place to exercise and relax. As I am new to the country and the city of Abu Dhabi, I searched through the city to find a nice place to engage with local community, and also improve my health conditions. It turns out that The Bridge is the place that you can do both!

On the same day Mr Hamza gave a tour to myself and my partner, we decided that this is the place to be. The following months proved us right. If you would like to have a tour of the place, please make sure to ask for Mr Hamza, he will guide you through all the facilities, packages, and take care of you for all the aftermaths. I truly appreciate his help!

Well, Mr Hamza is not the only one you can rely on, Mr Lan from the Krave restaurant on the ground floor has consistently shown his hospitality every time I visit the restaurant. The services with the valet parking, the SPA facilities, and the reception, are all exceptional. At the end of the workout, I could choose to relax in the sauna, or have a walk along the creek in the Al Qana complex. If anyone knows any other place can beat this experience? Please let me know, because so far this is the best place in Abu Dhabi I could find.

As comfortable as I already am, there are still other facilities I have not used often, such as the rooftop pool, group classes, and community activities. I am sure they will not disappoint. My partner is super hyped about the puppy yoga event and marked in her agenda long before the event itself.

All in all, I could wholeheartedly recommend this place. A well-deserved 5-star!
owner_answer:
Dear Zijian,

Thank you so muchfor taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. We are truly delighted to know that THE BRIDGE has become a welcoming place for you to both connect with the community and take care of your wellbeing here in Abu Dhabi.

We’re very happy to hear your kind words about Hamza and Lan, we will be sure to pass along your appreciation to them and the rest of the team. It’s wonderful to know you enjoyed our facilities, hospitality, and overall experience, and we can’t wait for you to explore even more of what we offer, from rooftop pool time to group classes and our community events.

We are grateful for your trust and recommendation, and we look forward to continuing to support you and your partner on your wellness journey.

Regards,
THE BRIDGE Team

name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
I couldn’t believe I’d ever write a bad review about The Bridge. I’ve been a member for almost 3 years, and my fitness journey started here. I used to love this gym — it felt like home. But now, I’m honestly heartbroken and extremely disappointed. The Bridge has changed — and not in a good way.

Let’s start with the ladies’ gym: it’s still the same tiny studio, with barely any equipment. We have one Smith machine, one shoulder machine, two back machines, and that’s it. The heaviest plate is only 15kg. I’ve requested so many times — for a leg press, hip thrust machine, abductor, back machines, and more plates. Not once did I get a reply. Every time I ask who to talk to, I’m told “Admissions doesn’t want to change anything.” So who’s actually listening to the members?

They recently added a new cardio studio, but it’s on the other side of the gym on the same floor, separated by just some curtains. It’s a very small area with maybe 4 cardio machines and 2 stair masters. That’s not enough for the number of women using the gym, and it doesn’t fix the bigger issue — the lack of proper weight training equipment.

Then there’s the ladies-only timing — from 9 AM to 12 PM on weekdays. Most of us work during those hours, and for the few who can go, it’s still not enough time. I’ve raised this point before too, and once again, nothing changes.

What frustrates me most is the renewal process. They used to offer small discounts for loyal members. This year, I got nothing — just a higher price, and now I’m paying more than double what I originally paid. And for what? The ladies’ section hasn’t improved at all. It feels like we’re being overcharged and ignored. How can prices keep going up, but the services stay the same — or worse?

I miss the old Bridge. The coaches back then were amazing — they knew us by name, brought energy to every class, and made the gym feel like a real community. Now, most of them are gone. Some of the new coaches have no energy, don’t engage with the class, and just go through the motions. Even the staff and security have changed, and it’s just not the same vibe anymore.

The Bridge keeps changing, but not for the better. All we ask for is a well-equipped ladies’ gym, proper communication, and coaches who care. I never thought I’d say this, but the gym that once felt like my second home now just feels like a business that stopped caring.

name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
I’ve been a loyal member of this gym for years, but sadly, I can no longer recognize the place I once loved. What used to feel like a vibrant, welcoming space now feels cold, disconnected, and lifeless. The recent “revamp” seems more like a downgrade — equipment awkwardly shuffled around with no aesthetic or functional improvement. The layout feels rushed and uninspired.

We used to have energy. Community. Happy hours. Coaches who actually cared. Even the baristas knew your name and your order. Now? Most of the good coaches and managers are gone, and so are the familiar faces that made this gym feel like home. It’s disheartening. And every time concerns are raised, the answer is always: “Change is a natural part of any organization.” But change is meant to bring progress not decline. That phrase is being used to justify poor decisions, not meaningful growth.

The pricing is unstable, the environment is dull, and frankly, I regret renewing my membership this year. It used to be a place we looked forward to — now it just feels like any other gym trying to imitate what it once was.. this is my last year joining for sure.
owner_answer:
Dear F M, 

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your honest feedback with us. We genuinely appreciate your loyalty and the years you have spent as part of THE BRIDGE community.

We are truly sorry to hear that you feel the atmosphere and experience have not met your expectations recently. Please be assured that your sentiments matter greatly to us, and we take them very seriously.

We fully acknowledge that some of the points you have raised might highlight areas we can improve however, we would appreciate the opportunity to better understand your concerns in more detail. Our management team is always available and more than happy to listen, clarify any misunderstandings, and discuss how we can address any issues together.

Our aim has always been to create a vibrant, welcoming environment that feels like a second home for our members. If you are open to it, we would love to sit down with you in person to hear your thoughts and suggestions so that we can work towards bringing back that sense of community and energy you remember so fondly.

Please feel free to reach out to us directly on Life@thebridgehub.com at any time or stop by the front desk so we can arrange a convenient time to meet.

Thank you once again for your feedback and for being such an important part of The Bridge. We genuinely hope we can regain your trust and make your experience here enjoyable once more.

THE BRIDGE Management

name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text: Before anything I must say, staff are great and my review is not about them in any way, I actually love the team. This review is for girls looking for comments and deciding if this gym is worth it or not, it’s not. If you’re a working woman, the gym ladies timing is only accessible from 9 AM to 12 PM which is not convenient for any woman who works. only 1 studio is accessible during the full day which is the size of a bedroom, literally. The studio does not accommodate more than 10 people at the same time, not enough machines, people cram unhygienically and its just too much. Moreover, since I first joined in 2023 they have been promising to upgrade and extend the ladies area, and we kept sharing our feedback and expressing how small the ladies area is and they kept promising to make the experience better. 2 years and a half later, NOTHING. They extended the ladies area this Ramadan (March) until we received an email in June stating that the extension is removed and we’re back to the studio lol, again, the studio that is the size of a bedroom literally. So it’s my first day back after they removed the extension on the 9th of june. I tried to go in and funny enough, there was a class happening at that time! Meaning that if you want to go to the gym, you have to check prior and make sure that theres no class taking place in the studio when you wanna go to the gym, meaning, you have a membership for a gym that you cannot go to at your convenience  but at theirs hahaha. I ended up waiting for 45 mins until the class ended and I went in and was horrified by the unpleasant smell. Idk how ADOSH or AD quality & conformity allowing this. Honestly, I only joined because there weren’t any classy options in AD back then but luckily there are many (newly 😉) opened gyms with MUCH bigger spaces, better hygiene and rates tbh
owner_answer:
Hi Afra,
First, we want to thank you for your kind words about our team. They work hard to create a welcoming environment, and it means a lot to see that recognized.

Regarding your feedback: from day one, THE BRIDGE has been positioned as a mixed wellness space with dedicated ladies’ timings, classes, and a ladies-friendly area and not a fully private ladies-only gym. We have always been transparent about this, and all new members are given full tours and details before choosing to join.

Over time, we have actively listened to feedback and trialled multiple adjustments, including the recent Ramadan extension, to improve comfort for all members. Unfortunately, that specific trial had a negative impact on the broader experience, which is why it was removed. We are continuing to look for long-term solutions that maintain balance for everyone.

Ultimately, we understand that THE BRIDGE may be a great fit for some, and not for others, and we fully respect each person’s right to choose what suits their needs best.

Your feedback is valuable, and we thank you again for taking the time to share it.

Regards,
THE BRIDGE Management

name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
This used to be a standout gym top-tier equipment, dynamic classes, and a real sense of community. It wasn’t just about fitness it was about culture. Coaches actually knew your name, pushed you the right way, and made showing up feel worth it.

Then management changed and everything else followed. They’ve let go of the very people who built this place up the coaches who gave the gym its pulse. In return, we got leadership that’s out of touch, uninspired, and frankly, unqualified to run a space that relies on connection and adaptability.

Unplanned situation? They freeze. They follow “policy” like it’s gospel because they don’t know how to lead without a script.

It’s not just disappointing it’s quite embarrassing. A masterclass in how to kill a great thing with corporate mediocrity.
owner_answer:
Hi Hev,

I’m Philip the General Manager at THE BRIDGE. I read your review personally, and I want to start by saying: I’m sorry that this has been your experience recently.
The culture you described, where coaches know your name and positive energy and community drive the member experience is exactly what my team and I strive for everyday. If that’s felt different lately, then it’s on us to understand why and to fix it. 
Like any diverse and growing business, we have from time to time to make difficult decisions and changes, and while we always try to do what’s best for our community and the long-term health of the space, I fully understand how sometimes those choices can impact our members.

I’d genuinely appreciate the chance to meet in person to get a deeper understanding of your experience here at THE BRIDGE, both positive and negative. Listening to the feedback from our members is part of how we can grow even better. If you’re open to a chat, please send your contact details to life@thebridgehub.com, and I’ll arrange a time that suits you.
Thank you for your feedback. I take your words seriously, and hopefully through open discourse we can take the necessary steps to level up.

Regards,
Philip

name: Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island, Abu Dhabi
review_text:
My visit to Warner Bros. World was nothing short of magical, and it is an experience I will cherish for a very long time. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the attention to detail, the immersive atmosphere, and how every corner truly brings the world of Warner Bros. characters to life. Each area felt like stepping straight into a movie or cartoon I grew up loving, and the overall organisation and cleanliness of the park were excellent.
My favourite ride was green latern.
What truly made my visit exceptional, however, was the outstanding support and kindness of a staff member named Jennifer from Cameroon. Jennifer went above and beyond her role to ensure I had the best possible experience. She took her time to patiently explain each ride to me, making sure I fully understood what to expect before going on them. Her explanations were clear, engaging, and thoughtful, which helped me feel comfortable and excited rather than overwhelmed.
What stood out most was her deep knowledge and passion for the park. Jennifer didn’t just explain the rides; she also shared the history behind the characters and the stories that inspired each attraction. Listening to her brought the entire experience to life in a meaningful way, allowing me to appreciate the creativity and legacy of Warner Bros. on a deeper level. She answered all my questions with genuine enthusiasm and never made me feel rushed.
Jennifer’s friendly attitude and willingness to help made me feel truly welcomed and valued as a guest. It is rare to meet someone who combines excellent customer service with such sincerity and dedication, and she is truly a credit to Warner Bros. World.
Because of Jennifer, my visit was not just fun, but memorable and enriching. I left the park with a smile, wonderful memories, and a deeper appreciation.I highly recommend Warner Bros. World to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience, and I sincerely hope other visitors get the chance to be guided by someone as amazing as Jennifer. She truly made my day special.

name: Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island, Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I am a theme-park enthusiast and I’ve traveled visiting many parks and resorts all over the world.

What I found at Warner Bros World just blew me away! Although I had done my homework and studied the park in advance (reading thru the website and watching vlogging YouTube videos) I was still shocked by the high-level quality of experience this park offered!

My son and I visited on New Year’s Eve and although we were told the park would be really busy because of the holidays — it was still a very manageable experience… nothing compared to a busy day at Disneyland 🤣

The first two hours of the day were the least busiest… a good time to visit the more popular attractions (Batman: Knight Flight and Tom & Jerry’s Spin)

But throughout the day we were able to enjoy ourselves at a good and simple pace… some rides… popcorn… character interactions (…and I mean intentional interactions, not just photos!)… strolling through the park taking photos (beautiful and detailed scenery throughout the whole place)… ribeye steak lunch in Bedrock… show in the main hall area… such an amazing time.

I have to say… Warner Bros World in Abu Dhabi is one of the best! And I’ll tell you why:

1. Excellent and Friendly Employees!!! I know this should be a given when dealing with the service industry… but more and more many theme parks are beginning to lower their standards in this area. However, I found every single employee at WB World to be so absolutely friendly, helpful and excellent in their area of service. While shopping in the Bedrock Boutique, two employees: Pride and Bushra, gave me FIRST CLASS shopping experience… walking me through the store and helping me to find everything Flintstone that I wanted (I’m a huge Fred Flintstone fan!)… big friendly smiles and wonderful conversations about the local area and culture. These friendly employees really make a difference in making you feel welcomed and in having such an enjoyable day in the park!

2. Character Interactions. Not only can you meet and get a photo with the characters, but they actually take time to interact with you. For example, Robin and Batwomen took no less than 5 minutes talking to us, asking us questions, making funny jokes and just making our experience so much more fun! They were amazing! Later on, we met the Flintstones and although they can’t talk, they made motions and communicated in creative ways… again, interacting and making the whole experience so much more than just taking a photo. It’s a higher level of theming altogether. Just amazing.

3. Awesome rides and attractions! I’ve visited Warner Bros Movie World in Australia (and I love it there!) but the rides and attractions at this Warner Bros World are so much more different and highly themed. I kept telling my son “these rides are so world-class” — they could easily compete alongside anything at Disney. Creative and fun… just loved them all! My favorite was the Bedrock River Adventure, but that’s because I’m a huge Flintstones fan! Love what they did with them here… and I hope they’ll never get rid of this area. I grew up in the years when Hanna-Barbera cartoons were the main programs we watched on Saturday morning television… it’s so nostalgic to see these cartoons coming back to life here at this park. Cartoon Junction was also another favorite area with Tom & Jerry, Scooby Doo and the Looney Tunes! My son (in his twenties) really loved the Metropolis and Gotham areas and attractions in this park.

Also notable mentions for the delicious food selections and many places to sit and relax in the park. Worldclass attraction that should be visited by anyone looking to have a fun day at a theme park. Loved it so much!

review_text:
White Club Abu Dhabi — Extremely Disappointing Experience

My wife (52) and I (54) attended the “Old School Jam” event on 05 December 2025 and spent approximately four hours at the venue. We were initially welcomed very well, and the atmosphere at entry was pleasant.

However, this positive first impression was completely overshadowed by what followed. Over the course of the evening, we each had a few drinks — certainly no more than 10 per person. When we requested our bill upon leaving, we were shocked to be presented with a total of AED 2,000. Even more concerning, no itemized receipt was provided despite asking for one.

Without a transparent breakdown of charges, it is impossible to verify what we were actually billed for. This lack of billing transparency is unacceptable and left us feeling extremely uncomfortable and taken advantage of.

Unfortunately, this experience has completely eroded our trust in this establishment. We will not be returning and would strongly advise others to exercise caution and always insist on itemized billing before settling payment.

Very disappointed with White Club in Abu Dhabi.
Today my friends and I had an extremely unpleasant experience. We ordered specific drinks, but they brought us something completely different and, what is even more outrageous, charged us double the price for it! When we immediately said that we did not order those drinks, the waiter was incredibly rude, spoke to us arrogantly, and made no attempt to fix the issue.

The service is absolutely not what you would expect from a place that positions itself as high-end. Instead of apologizing and correcting the mistake, the staff acted as if we were at fault for placing an order at all. The atmosphere, which was supposed to be enjoyable, turned into a stressful experience — our evening was completely ruined.

I have been to many venues in Abu Dhabi, and I have never encountered such treatment towards customers. It is unacceptable to charge for something we did not order and then show such disrespect.

I do not recommend this club to anyone who values honesty, respectful service, and a pleasant experience. There are plenty of other places in the city where you can enjoy your time without this kind of negativity. White Club in Abu Dhabi is definitely not worth the money or attention.

name: Manchester City Challenge
review_text:
Ultimate Fan Experience Must-Try Football Adventure at Yas Mall! From the moment I stepped into the Manchester City Challenge at Yas Mall’s Sports Boulevard, I was blown away by the immersive atmosphere. The venue is styled like the Etihad Stadium, complete with a replica dressing room and a Trophy Hall filled with the club’s iconic silverware perfect for any die-hard or casual fan
The attraction features 14+ interactive football challenges, including shooting, speed, reflex, agility, and accuracy drills. One highlight was taking a penalty against a robot goalkeeper by far the most thrilling part of the experience.I also really enjoyed exploring the Players’ Tunnel and walking through the kit gallery tracing the club’s history since 1884
The experience kicks off with creating a personalized avatar via RFID tech that tracks your performance a nice touch that makes you feel like a City legend-in-training The setup is seamless, and it’s great for all ages: families, friends, corporate groups, or solo fans it’s built to entertain everyone from ages 5 and up
Staff presence really elevated my visit. Trainers were enthusiastic, encouraging, and skilled at coaching through each challenge. As one The Manchester City Challenge is a standout entertainment experience in Abu Dhabi a perfect blend of sports, technology, and fan culture. It’s ideal for anyone looking for active fun, engaging challenges, or a way to connect with Man City’s legacy. I had an unforgettable time and can't recommend it highly enough I'll definitely return with friends and family!

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text: WOOOOOOW, SPENT 3 DAYS IN F1, AMAZING

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
We were super excited to see the F1 final race of the season, especially when there were 3 drivers in the running; it made it all the more interesting! We had tickets for the South Grandstand, but our coach could only drop us off by the West Grandstand. You can only enter the tracks where your tickets are. So we walked what seems like miles in the midday heat to find our entrance.
Once we arrived, they scanned our tickets and our bags. No food and drink were allowed in. We had empty bottles in the bag and they threw that away! We were saving them to use at the water stations!

There were plenty of food choices available but they were the same in each grandstand area. We just got some food near our seats!

We had plenty of time before Quali to explore, but with the sheer amount of people, it took forever to get even from South to West Grandstand!

The Quali and the final race were amazing in such a beautiful track. The atmosphere was amazing with the fly past at the beginning and the brilliant fireworks display at the end!

The seats were cheap and uncomfortable to sit on for long hours! Plus the steps down to your seats were steep, so not good if you are afraid of heights!

Leaving the race on both days were carnage! We wanted to get a shuttle to Yas Mall afterwards, but it was impossible to get near a bus with soooooo many people pushing to get in. In the end we walked an hour to the Mall! On actual race day, there was no point considering a shuttle bus and getting a taxi was impossible! So we ended up walking 2 miles (2 hours) towards West Yas to get a taxi!

The race weekend was a phenomenal experience, but the logistics of getting out of the circuit was off putting.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the customer service at Yas Marina.
I was unable to travel to Dubai due to unexpected immigration restrictions related to my passport, and I contacted Yas Marina well in advance to request a reschedule, refund, or even a simple gift voucher so I wouldn’t completely lose my money.
They refused every option and showed no flexibility or empathy, despite the situation being completely outside my control. Most reputable attractions offer at least a credit or alternative date when a guest cannot travel due to official entry restrictions, but Yas Marina chose not to help at all.
This experience has left me feeling frustrated and unheard.
I would strongly caution others to consider the lack of customer support before booking here, especially if you are travelling internationally and may face unexpected travel issues.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
My first F1 experience at Yas was nothing short of incredible. I was there on Friday and Saturday, and watched almost all the events that took place.

Masters Historic Racing, Formula 4, Formula 2, Pirelli Hot Laps, then F1 events. There’s a lot to watch and it rewards you for getting there early.

I saw some reviews saying that they missed the race due to congestion, but I feel like that’s really their on responsibility to be timely and expect that kind of delay the closer you are to the main event. Just come early! There’s plenty to do.

I parked at Yas Mall and used the shuttles which were great, but, on the main race day the post-race walk to Yas Mall is not bad as long as you follow the clear signage and cut through Ferrari World (not the directions on your Maps Application). It was about 30-40 minutes, which is what you will end up waiting in line for an extremely packed shuttle anyway. This is honestly expected at an event of this scale, and all I felt was it was quite well organized for a scale of this size.

There was good food, staff were attentive and the atmosphere was breathtaking. I hope to have the opportunity to visit again one day.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
Отвратительная организация гран-при Абу-Даби 2025

Мы опоздали на финальную гонку на 20 минут по вине организаторов. Из отеля мы вышли за 3 часа до гонки.

Первые 1,5ч мы пытались пройти пешком по маршруту из специального приложения, но 3 ближайших к отелю гейта были закрыты и толпы людей сливались в один вход. Это было невозможно пройти и простоять по жаре, и мы пошли на автобус.

У нас был билет Sunset lounge, который предусматривает отдельный трансфер до трека на специальном автобусе от молла. От отеля на трансфер не сесть.

За 1,5ч до гонки автобусы перестали ездить и сформировалась огромная очередь (фото людей за нами прикреплено). С нами стояли в одних условиях даже люди из паддока. За 1,5ч приехало 2 автобуса. За !!!!!1,5ч!!!!!! 2 автобуса. Это ненормально. Нас забрал второй автобус и мы ехали по пробке, никакой отдельной выеденной полосы нет. Старт гонки мы смотрели из автобуса на телефоне, имея на руках билет. Очень дорогой билет. Это ужасно.

По другую сторону молла были автобусы для других типов билетов. Сотни людей стояли на самом пекле и аналогично ждали их.

Обычный билет на трибуну = отсутствие организации, закрытые гейты, ожидание автобусов на пекле.
Билет в ~10 раз дороже в лаунж = то же самое, только автобус ждут поменьше людей и в тени.

Билет повышенного класса предусматривает комфорт логистики, никакого комфорта не было.

Билеты по типу Sunset lounge на гп Абу-Даби однозначно не советую. Это покупка испорченных впечатлений. Оно того абсолютно не стоит.

Еще проблемы:
1)Логистика и без опоздания автобуса ужасна:

В стоимость билета не включена парковка на территории, хотя на карте эта она обозначена!!!!  На физической карте, которая стоит у въезда на территорию трека. Фото с доказательством прикреплено.

Билет повышенного класса ДОЛЖЕН включать парковку, либо должна быть возможность докупить место.

На территории есть огромное количество парковочных мест, но они простаивают пустыми.

Шаттлы не работают нормально в день гонки, люди опаздывают.

2)Волонтеры ничего не знают и только путают.

В первый день мы аналогично добирались 3 часа, потому что одни нам говорили одно, в билете написано второе, водитель автобуса говорит третье.

3)Пешие маршруты не продуманы. Люди идут вдоль забора по траве, песку и камням, потому что так быстрее.

4)Места внутри Лаунжа не продуманы. Необходимо приходить заранее и занимать место, чтобы видеть трассу и экран. Людям сзади при этом обзора не будет, либо он будет сильно хуже.

Это нормально для недорогих билетов, в билетах в несколько раз дороже это должно быть предусмотрено и продумано.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Zuma today and it honestly couldn’t have been a better experience. From the moment we sat down, the service and hospitality stood out just as much as the food and drinks.

A special shout-out to Kamal, our main server. He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. He checked on us at just the right times, always had an eye on our table without hovering, and even refolded our napkins every time we left the table – those small details that really make you feel looked after. He was warm, easy to talk to, asked if we were new to Zuma and the brunch, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout.

We also had the pleasure of being looked after by Apollo, the sommelier. He was incredibly patient, humble and kind, with a calm, warm presence that makes you want to sit and chat with him about wine all afternoon. His recommendations were spot on, and you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. He explained the wines in a simple, friendly way and was very accommodating to our preferences. Just a great person to have guiding us through the wine list.

Another special mention to Dominique. He wasn’t even serving our table, but he was one of the only team members walking past who noticed the “Happy Anniversary” message on our dessert plate and acknowledged it. As people from the hospitality industry ourselves, we really appreciate those tiny touches of awareness and genuine guest care. That simple moment of recognition says a lot about him and about Zuma’s culture. He has a spark of personality that will definitely take him a long way and adds to the Zuma brand.

The food was outstanding – we left absolutely stuffed. The quality of the produce, especially the seafood and the raw dishes, really sets Zuma apart from other high-end places. You can taste the intention and care behind every plate. The wines were excellent, and even the coffee smelled and tasted amazing.

Overall, an incredible anniversary brunch. Huge thanks to Kamal, Apollo, Dominique and the rest of the Zuma team for making our day so special. 🌟🍷🍣 Highly recommended.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma never misses. Whether it’s lunch or dinner, the experience is top-tier from start to finish. I’ve been here more times than I can count and it’s consistently excellent, food, service, vibe, all on point.

The business lunch is one of the best deals in Abu Dhabi, generous portions, great variety, and perfectly executed dishes. You walk out full, satisfied, and still on schedule. For dinner, it’s a whole other level, dim lighting, smooth music, and that signature Zuma buzz that somehow makes even Tuesday feel like a Friday.

Favorites? Always the spicy beef tenderloin, black cod, sushi platter, and that dangerously good green tea banana cake. Cocktails? Sophisticated without trying too hard. Service? Polished, but human.

If I had one suggestion, maybe a couple more rotating seasonal specials or AD-exclusive dishes could keep things extra fresh for regulars like me. But honestly? Still five stars. Zuma is a benchmark for what dining in Abu Dhabi should feel like.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I have been dining at Zuma Abu Dhabi for over 11 years, and I have never experienced something this alarming. Today, I found a strange soft, purplish object in my salad  much larger than what was later shown to me and it was breaking apart when touched. The moment I saw it, I felt immediate stomach discomfort and a strong urge to vomit.
For a fine dining restaurant of this level, this is extremely unacceptable. The team told me they would “investigate,” but this should not happen in a place known for hosting high-profile guests and operating in a country with strict health and safety standards.
I am truly disappointed, and I hope the management takes this matter seriously. This experience was shocking and far from what I expect from Zuma.

review_text: 12 out of 10. The food was top-notch. Every meal we ordered was crafted in a uniquely “Zuma” way. Even something as simple as the soy beans (Edamame) was elevated beautifully. The request for a medium cook on our Wagyu was spot-on. The wine selection was amazing. The look and feel of Zuma is and always has been one of my favorites. He went above and beyond in getting our wine to the preferred temperature. His recommendation of the Nanakanba Umeshu (Plum wine) was a definite winner! And a huge thank you to Daniel. name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma Abu Dhabi is absolutely amazing! Every time I visit, the experience is perfect from start to finish. The restaurant has a beautiful modern design with a warm and elegant atmosphere — perfect lighting, great music, and a lively vibe that makes it feel special the moment you walk in.

The food is incredible. Every dish is prepared with so much care and flavor — the sushi, black cod, and wagyu beef are on another level. The presentation is beautiful, and you can really taste the quality of every ingredient. Even the desserts are a work of art — the Zuma chocolate fondant is a must-try!

The staff are very professional, polite, and attentive without being too much. They always make sure everything is just right. The outdoor terrace is also stunning, especially during sunset with the beautiful Abu Dhabi skyline in view.

Yes, it’s a premium restaurant, but honestly worth every dirham for the quality, service, and atmosphere you get.

If you’re looking for the best dining experience in Abu Dhabi, I highly recommend Zuma — elegant, delicious, and unforgettable every single time.
